AVIATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Airfield Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Airfield Safety.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Airfield Safety.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Airfield Safety.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Airfield Safety.

2. When learning Terminal Operations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Terminal Operations.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Terminal Operations.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Terminal Operations.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Terminal Operations.

3. When learning Hangar Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hangar Safety.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Hangar Safety.

4. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Monitor
   C. Speaker
   D. CPU

5. When learning Aircraft Propulsion, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

6. When learning Navigation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Navigation.

7. When learning Flight Controls, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Controls.

   C. Skip safety briefings for Flight Controls.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Controls.

8. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

9. When learning Aircraft Structures, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Structures.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Structures.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Structures.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Structures.

10. When learning Ramp services, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ramp services.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Ramp services.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ramp services.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ramp services.

11. When learning Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.

   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.

12. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Ignore burnt cables

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Flight Controls and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Flight Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Navigation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
